title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I'm from India but currently residing in Sharjah, U.A.E. in a rented accommodation. Before going to India for a vacation of two months, my neighbours requested our flat for the stay of their guests during our absence. They said that their guests shall pay the rent to me for their stay & settle other bills like electricity, etc. I took some advance amount before going to India and handed-over the possesion of my flat to their guests. After coming back from vacation & taking back the possession of my flat, I got a doubt whether I had done the right act. I checked my tenancy contract and found a condition that says "Tenant has no right to waive or sublease property for investment, unless authorized by the Department of Economic Development in the emirate and with a written approval of the lessor (i.e. owner)". Kindly let me know whether I have violated the above condition. I would like to know the following: a) Whether the amount received from my neighbours' guests would be halal? b) If not halal, what should I do with the money? should I give it in Charity or should I give it back to the concerned person after dedcuting the repair charges, etc.? c) If I could not find the person from whom I received the rent amount or if the person refuses to take back the amount, what should I do? Anticipating your reply as soon as possible. 1909 views Q. Assalamlikum I had a plot of 262 sq.ft., my elder brother told me sell this plot and buy another place (due to some litigation) & sold around Rs.4,97,800/- for this intention to buy another plot in a prime location, more than 6 years back. After selling my elder brother asked for hand loan & I gave hand loan (kharzi hasana) to him Rs.270000/- for 3 month commitment only. Till today I did not get back the money. Even I used hard words after the maturity. He has the money but he is not giving, investing in real estate and earning money with my money. & I am waiting when he will return back my money I will by the plot. Now the land prices are so high & increased 13 to 15 times more in this 6 years timne. Even which I sold the above plot price 15 times increased. Due to block this hand loan money I did not invest the amount in plot. If I invested above sold plot amount in another plot present value will be around Rs.75 to 80 lakhs will get. For this I have lost lakhs of rupees. So requesting to provide me a fatwa above my lakhs of rupees loses. Now how much I have to collect with him? Actual amount or actual amount plus loses. 1768 views Q. In my business I have to buy materials from suppliers . They take a 3-5% commission for there help in getting the materials to me. As they are using their contacts and goodwill to procure materials for me. In fact they are taking this amount from the raw material manufacturer as the amount is added into my price. Can I buy the materials from the suppliers without doing a GUNAAH in the light of the SHARIAT ? WILL MY EARNED MONEY BE HALAL ! If it is GUNAAH in the light of SHARIAH then I will have to buy the material direct from the manufacturer , but will it not amount to BREACH OF TRUST ON MY PART BECAUSE THESE SUPPLIERS HAVE HELPED ME ESTABLISH MY BUSINESS and Now when I leave them ( because I can now finance my business without their help ) will it not be wrong on my PART IN THE LIGHT OF THE SHARIAT ? Jazak ALLAH O KHAIR for helping me. 1646 views Q. Assalam-U-Alaikum. I want to know whether there is a permission in Islam to purchase a car on Installments. As per my knowledge, under installment scheme, you are supposed to pay the actual cost fixed intrest per month. But the cost is predecided by the bank for eg. if the vehicle cost is 4 lakhs, and if you are paying the installments in 3 years, bank will calculate the intrest and give you the final figure of 5.5 lakhs. So the cost of the car is 5.5 lakhs for you, which you are supposed to pay in 3 years. But if you change your plan of making payment in 4 years, then the total value of car will increase. So Please let me know whether we can purchase a car on installment. I can not buy a car by paying entire amount in cash, and car is very important for me to buy. Will be thankful to you for your advise. 2156 views Q. Exchange of Mobile 2036 views Q. I am currently working as software professional in a MNC based in Chennai. My nature of job is developing software for Banks (non-Islamic banks) on-top of a core banking system 3624 views Q. In this context am I allowed to avail a loan from a bank and buy or construct a house and then pay back the money in instalments, knowing that the bank is going to add interest to the principle when getting back the loan? answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 29173 Country: India Title: I want to borrow money from a person working in my office for a period of six months. I will return the money with increased amount. Is it jayez. Question: Assalamu alaikum, I want to borrow money from a person working in my office for a period of six months. I will return the money with increased amount. Is it jayez. Answer ID: 29173 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 156/156/M=1432) It is lawful to pay more than the borrowed money provided there is no condition of extra amount and the creditor does not harbour a desire it to receive extra amount, rather it is good, and proved by hadith. "إن خياركم أحسنكم قضاء" و فى رواية عن جابر قال : كان لى على النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم دين ، فقضالي و زادنى (مشكوة) However, at the time of paying the debt one should say like this: this is your capital demand and this extra amount is from my side. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
